rights_basis: The printing reproduced here was published at Paris in 1894, before 1931, and is in the public domain in the United States: the repository's own rights reading, recorded at guidance/missals.md section 5 against Cornell's public-domain chart current at 1 January 2026, is that a work first published abroad before 1931 is in the public domain with no term running. The Internet Archive's optical character recognition of a public-domain printing is a mechanical transcription that adds no original authorship, is served without a copyright claim asserted over it, and carries none of the host's markup, navigation or apparatus; a search of the whole file finds no 'Google' and no 'usage guidelines' string. The bytes are retained because guidance/sources.md makes retention the project-wide default and none of its three exemptions reaches this file: it may lawfully be republished, it is not restricted, and at 4.21 MB it is well within what this library already retains.
